Sam (eng-release): Heads up — planning deploy tomorrow 2028-06-15 09:30 PT (16:30 UTC). Need smoke owners, rollback readiness, and CS/Marketing copy for release notes. Who can own smoke?
Maria (product): I can own the release notes copy. Will post snippets by EOD today.
Tess (customer success): I can coordinate CS playbook and support ticket blurb. Will sync w/ on-call.
Jonathan (sre): I'll own smoke checks and rollback runbook. Need a quick checklist from QA.
QA (qa): Pinging with a minimal smoke checklist now:
```
- /health sanity check (GET /health -> 200)
- basic generation smoke: POST /v1/generate with prompt "hello" -> valid token stream
- p95 latency target: < 300ms for small prompt
- KV cache sanity: run a two-step chat to ensure context kept
- canary account: use `canary-smoke` API key
- quick perf: run 5 requests, look for OOM or GPU throttling
- rollback dry-run: ./scripts/rollback.sh --dry-run v1.2.3->v1.2.2
```
Sam (eng-release): Perfect. Jonathan, can you confirm you'll run the smoke at +5 and +30 after cut? Also can you validate autoscale spike?
Jonathan (sre): Yep. I'll hit +5, +30. I'll also watch throughput and trigger a manual scale if p95 > 500ms. Have the rollback script ready; I tested locally.
Li (marketing): For marketing, short note looks like: "New low-latency optimizer + routing improvements — reduces inference cost for chat workloads. Docs + benchmarks linked." I can share full hero copy by 11:00 PT.
Maria (product): Great. For release notes bullets I'll include: 1) perf regressions/benchmarks 2) default route change and impact 3) how to opt-out (pin model vX). Posting draft at 20:45 PT.
Tess (customer success): CS playbook:
- Pre-release: email to major customers (list attached)
- During: CS on-call monitor channel + run canned responses
- Post: survey for any regression reports
I'll upload the canned responses tomorrow morning.
Sam (eng-release): Who's doing the final promote at 09:30 PT? I'll be AFK 09:10-09:20. Prefer Jonathan or Maria to press go.
Jonathan (sre): I can promote at 09:30 if Sam isn't available. Maria can sanity check the release notes right after.
Maria (product): Happy to confirm notes immediately after promote.
deploy-bot: Dry-run pipeline succeeded: build-1834 -> all smoke steps passed in staging environment. :white_check_mark:
QA (qa): One more ask: include a tiny traffic shadowing window for 10 minutes before promote to catch surprises. Should be low risk.
Sam (eng-release): Good call — add 10m shadowing at 09:20 PT then promote at 09:30. Jonathan, can you run the rollback script dry-run at 09:25 to validate ops path?
Jonathan (sre): Will do 09:25 dry-run, log saved to /var/log/deploy/1834567890-rollback-dryrun.log and post link.
Tess (customer success): Noted for CS: we'll stand up a ticker in #support for 09:30-10:30 PT and be ready with rollback responses.
Li (marketing): I'll freeze hero copy at 11:00 PT and schedule the public tweet at 11:15 PT if no issues.
Sam (eng-release): OK this is our checklist summary (copying into the thread):
```
- 09:20 PT: 10m traffic shadowing (canary accounts)
- 09:25 PT: rollback dry-run (Jonathan)
- 09:30 PT: promote to prod (Jonathan if Sam unavailable)
- +5m: smoke run (Jonathan/QA)
- +30m: secondary smoke run and perf check (Jonathan)
- 09:30-10:30 PT: CS monitoring (Tess)
- 11:00 PT: marketing hero copy freeze (Li)
```
Maria (product): I'll paste the release note bullets in here by 20:45 PT.
Jonathan (sre): Posted rollback dry-run log: https://internal.redwood/deploy/logs/1834567890-rollback-dryrun.log
deploy-bot: prod-canary health: green, no obvious infra alerts.
Sam (eng-release): Awesome. If no objections, we'll proceed with that timeline. Thumbs up here if you're good. :thumbsup:
Maria (product): :thumbsup:
Jonathan (sre): :thumbsup:
Tess (customer success): :thumbsup:
Li (marketing): :thumbsup:
QA (qa): :thumbsup:
Sam (eng-release): Thanks everyone — final note: if anyone spots a regression in the +5m smoke, call the rollback and we execute v1.2.2 in under 10 mins.
